The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] conducted a '''mission''' to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial communications hub|communications hub]] at [[Sunfall Peak]] in order to disrupt the communications link. The [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|operators]] split into two teams, [[Team Bantha|Bantha]] and [[Team Thumper|Thumper]]. Their transport was destroyed, but Bantha created a diversion at an administration center while Thumper infiltrated the hub to place explosives. [[Ryenne]] stole a shuttle to escape while Thumper completed the mission. Team Bantha then rendezvoused, with Ryenne hacking the door to allow them to escape. Alliance reinforcements then arrived.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The mission appears in the opening short narrative of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
